summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Hands-on experience building and validating precision spatial data pipelines, from image registration and depth estimation on physical inspection surfaces to route and obstacle-avoidance validation in ROS2 and CARLA simulation, all version-controlled through Git and Python-based tooling on Linux. Led a 25-member robotics team end to end, owning technical scope, PCB and sensor integration, and workshop-based training under shifting competition deadlines.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Owned end-to-end technical scope for a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, intaking and prioritizing mechanical, PCB, and sensor integration work under shifting competition deadlines.
Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE; documented sensor communication schematics over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback for team-wide reuse.
Ran 10+ technical workshops (Arduino, PCB design, SolidWorks), maintaining a consistent documentation and onboarding process as the team scaled beyond any one person.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Designed a custom wavelet bank (alpha-blended sym6+bior3.5) for a high-resolution image-stitching pipeline, iteratively improving alignment quality from PSNR 65 to PSNR 86 through methodical, repeatable validation passes.
Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling at ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction, validating each pass against ground-truth measurements.
Architected a full metal surface inspection pipeline combining image stitching, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation for high-stakes, repeatable defect detection.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated CARLA data pipelines (~5,000 YOLO, ~3,000 UFLD frames, zero manual annotation) using semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering to generate structured, validated training data.

Trained an adaptive control stack for lane-following, waypoint fallback, and obstacle avoidance; validated in Town02 against 30 vehicles and 10 pedestrians with zero collisions across multiple test runs.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and hand-computed forward kinematic transform chains (0T6) for a 6-DoF UR5e and 5-DoF AL5B; validated coordinate-frame accuracy against MoveIt and RViz URDF models in ROS2 Humble and ROS Noetic.
Planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on a physical UR5e via the UR ROS2 driver; measured AL5B repeatability at <2mm over 10 trials through structured, repeatable test runs.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Diagnosed and resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture) through structured, evidence-based testing; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).
Integrated and validated a multi-sensor system (dual VL53L0X ToF + camera fused via TCA9548A I2C mux) across a distributed Jetson+Arduino pipeline, documenting each validation pass.
